12 Level Commission Structure

When you sign up for SES Membership, you get to choose your own personalized ID.  Every time you tell someone about SES, our computer will link their sale to you automatically. (We will provide you with an AutoTrak™ web link which will automatically credit you with the proper number of sales). 

By eliminating overhead costs such as shipping, packaging, warehousing, etc. - we can offer unheard of commissions to our members.  The table below is an example of commissions if 4 people signed up under you, and every successive person signed up just 4 people each...

Additionally, you will qualify for SES Bonus Levels.

This commissions plan is the result of a long-term SES study to determine the most effective payment structure in a large system.  It is BETTER than any other plan for 3 reasons:

1. 300 - the magic number:  Research has shown that once members reach the $300/mo commissions mark, they almost never quit the program.   This amazing commission structure allows you to reach that milestone in the THIRD level, with the model of 4's shown above.  Unheard of - this gives you a better chance at keeping a downline together indefinitely!

2. You choose how your group is structured:  We put your sales team in your hands!   If you choose to place most of your members in the 3rd or 5th level, be our guest!   It's your choice.  We have a TeamMachine™ that allows you to place your frontline members under any sponsor (in any level) you wish.   We found that by placing your members under other sponsors, downline growth becomes explosive!  Since there is no limit to how many members you can have in any level...well, you get the picture!

3. Long term growth: Since large downlines rarely stop growing after just a few levels, we made the plan 12 levels deep.  We don't require that you attain any certain sales before adding more levels like some plans do. Everyone gets the full long-term advantage that 12 unlimited levels gives you.  Plus, for those of you looking to make larger incomes, we placed a 10% bonus on level 6. 

There is no limit to how many people you can subscribe in each level, but if you use the model of 4's above you will achieve Bonus Levels faster.

Other than paying your normal subscription price (now only $12.95 per month!) and a small accounting/srvc fee ($1.95), there are no other fees involved in this program!  All you need to do to get started is sign up, and your ID, Password (for member's area) and AutoTrak™ link will be sent to you instantly via email!

Please note that this is not a get rich quick scheme,  in the beginning you may not make very much in commissions.  This type of group building structure is all about growing your downline, and it should start out as a secondary income.  (however, there are 45 new network marketing millionaires being created every day).  The above table is a mathematical model to help explain what type of payoff plan we offer. 

We are not here to disappoint you, so we aren't going to make any outrageous claims.  Network marketing is about steady growth proportional to the work you put into the program.  However, with 100 million people on the Internet today (plus one million more joining every month) you have a big advantage over traditional network marketing.  Just imagine how many people you could sign up using our Internet marketing tools!  We're willing to give you 30 full days to see for yourself.
